en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the turban for the deceased.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wrap it (around his head)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the turban for a deceased.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Wrap it around his head.’”
